name: container
comment: The gateway as a container image: built here and, when asked, pushed to a registry. There is no host to copy it to, so this target declares only the image; `rho deploy -docker` to a board uses that board's own docker block instead.

docker.comment: the gateway and the Rho toolchain are separate checkouts, so the image is built from two contexts, and the second is found in the workspace. RH_DEPLOY_DOCKER_IMAGE and _TAG name the image for a registry: RH_DEPLOY_DOCKER_IMAGE=<user>/robohub-gateway
